title: Resonance of Destiny
next_chapter_hook: As the millennium-spanning resonance of destiny subsided, an ancient key that belonged to no ordinary era appeared in Chen Ji's palm—Chen Tianming's final legacy, the sole key to unlock the door to the final battle.

text.content: The runes on the mural flowed like water, golden light bursting from the cracks and weaving an impenetrable net of light within the dark stone chamber. Chen Ji instinctively stepped back half a pace, true yuan already condensing in his palm—yet the light carried no aggression, instead bearing a heart-wrenching tenderness, like a mother's final embrace at death's door.

dialogue.content: Ji'er... If you can see this memory, it means you've reached a place I never could.

text.content: That voice was aged and weary, yet carried the familiar sensation of blood connection. Chen Ji's pupils contracted sharply—this was unmistakably his mother's voice! He had seen his mother's final moment in the Tianji Record Fragment's illusion, but never imagined hearing her again. However, the next instant, the scene shifted abruptly, revealing a figure he knew all too well.

dialogue.content: Father?! No... This isn't Father... This is Chen Tianming!

text.content: The figure in the mural bore an uncanny resemblance to his father's dying form in Chen Ji's memories, yet radiated a completely different aura—that of profound depth seasoned by vicissitudes and worldly understanding. Suddenly, Chen Ji comprehended something. Chen Tianming, his father, or rather, the one who granted him his bloodline, was no ordinary wandering cultivator, but the forty-ninth piece selected by the Tianji Record!

dialogue.content: Forty-ninth... The Tianji Record forged forty-nine pieces total, and you were the first to fulfill your destiny among the chess masters?

text.content: The Chen Tianming in the mural spoke slowly, his voice piercing through the barriers of time yet remaining crystal clear: 'My son, you've finally arrived. I've waited for this day,整整三千年.' The jade pendant at Chen Ji's chest suddenly blazed with heat—it was an intimate keepsake he had never parted with, yet now resonated with the mural. A surge of warmth gushed forth from the jade, spreading through his meridians to every limb and organ.

choice.prompt: Faced with his father's cross-temporal summons, Chen Ji chooses—

choices.text: Proactively open his divine sense, accepting the blood resonance
choices.description: Proactively establish a connection with Chen Tianming's residual will, enduring the impact of destiny's resonance, potentially gaining complete inherited memories.
choices.visible_cost: Endure the agony of bloodline impact
choices.visible_reward: Gain Chen Tianming's complete memories and partial cultivation inheritance
choices.risk_hint: If divine sense is insufficiently strong, may be devoured by Chen Tianming's memories

text.content: Chen Ji drew a deep breath and slowly released his divine sense's defenses. In an instant, countless images flooded into his mind like a torrent—Chen Tianming's entire life, from a spirited youth to a piece chosen by the Tianji Record, from the confrontation with the previous generation's Tianji Record guardian to meeting Chen Ji's mother. Each image carried excruciating pain, yet also brought unprecedented clarity of understanding.

dialogue.content: So... You knew all along this day would come, so you deliberately left this jade pendant, waiting for me to find you...

choices.text: Maintain vigilance, cautiously probe the light curtain
choices.description: Do not hastily accept, observe this memory from a bystander's perspective, ensuring the residual will does not influence his mind.
choices.visible_reward: Preserve complete divine sense, gain partial key information
choices.risk_hint: May miss the opportunity for deep inheritance

text.content: Chen Ji did not act rashly, but gently probed the light curtain with his divine sense. In an instant, the scene rippled like water, revealing the true vision hidden beneath the surface—Chen Tianming was not a willing piece, but forcibly chosen by the Heaven's Eye, with Chen Ji's mother's life used as leverage.

Just then, a blurry figure emerged from the mural's depths—a young woman's form, wearing a plain white robe, her features bearing a striking seven-point resemblance to Chen Ji. She stood beside Chen Tianming, her gaze piercing through temporal barriers, staring directly at Chen Ji. Those eyes contained complexities of emotion—longing, guilt, anticipation, and a trace of supplication barely detectable.

dialogue.content: Brother... You've finally arrived. I've waited so very long... I've missed you so much.

text.content: Chen Nian! Chen Ji's pupils contracted sharply, his heart feeling as if gripped by an invisible hand. His sister, whom he had searched for years believing long dead, now appeared before him in this most unexpected form. Her figure was illusory and wavering, clearly not a physical entity, but a fragmentary imprint of Chen Tianming's great magic left across time and space.

dialogue.content: Niannian! Tell me, where are you?! Where did the Holy Sect take you?!

text.content: The Chen Nian in the mural gently shook her head, a bitter smile forming on her face: 'Brother, I exist everywhere yet exist nowhere. The Heaven's Mandate Lock... My physical form has already become part of the Heaven's Eye, but Father sealed my consciousness within this jade pendant, waiting for this moment of resonance with you.' Chen Ji lowered his gaze to the jade pendant in his palm, suddenly discovering an entirely separate dimension within it—his sister's soul sealed within!

choice.prompt: After learning his sister's truth, Chen Ji must make a choice—

choices.text: Awaken his sister at any cost
choices.description: Use his own Heavenly Fate Value as a guide, forcibly unseal the jade pendant, awakening Chen Nian regardless of consequences.
choices.visible_reward: Chen Nian briefly awakens, gaining important information
choices.risk_hint: May cause oneself to fall into weakness, alerting enemies

text.content: Chen Ji did not hesitate for even a moment, pressing his palm against the jade pendant. True yuan within him surged forth like a tide. Heavenly Fate Value depleted at a terrifying rate, yet his gaze remained utterly unshaken. Chen Nian's form gradually solidified, those tightly closed eyes slowly opening, tears tracing down her illusory cheeks.

dialogue.content: Brother... Don't worry about me... First find the key Father left behind... The final door...

choices.text: Restrain emotions, act according to his sister's guidance
choices.description: Suppress the turmoil in his heart, first fulfill Chen Tianming's last wish, obtaining the key to unlock the final door.
choices.visible_cost: Temporarily suppress longing for his sister
choices.visible_reward: Gain complete inheritance and the key
choices.risk_hint: Chen Nian may fall into slumber again

text.content: Chen Ji's hand trembled slightly, yet in the end he slowly withdrew. Niannian was right—Father's legacy was the priority. He drew a deep breath, pressing all emotions into the deepest recesses of his heart, lifting his gaze toward the father and sister within the mural. 'I will rescue her, but first—tell me, where is that key?'

The Chen Tianming in the mural regarded his son, eyes holding both relief and regret. He raised his hand, pointing toward that seemingly ordinary stone wall at the chamber's deepest point: 'The key lies there. When you can perceive this memory, it means you've become worthy of inheriting it. But remember, Ji'er—this key can only be used once, and once used, your location will be utterly exposed beneath the Heaven's Eye's gaze.'

dialogue.content: I am not afraid of its sight.

text.content: Chen Ji's voice reverberated through the stone chamber,平静得近乎冷漠—calm to the point of cold indifference. His gaze seemed to penetrate that stone wall, already visualizing what lay hidden beyond—a door never before opened, a door connecting the final battlefield to the Heaven's Eye's本体. Chen Tianming's phantom slightly nodded, a serene smile appearing on his face.

dialogue.content: My son, you have walked farther than I did. But there is one thing you must know—the Heaven's Eye is not invincible. It has a fatal weakness, and this weakness... only the Chen bloodline can touch.

text.content: Chen Tianming's voice grew increasingly faint, the runes on the mural dimming visibly to the naked eye. He expended his final thread of strength, branding a piece of information directly into Chen Ji's Mental Sea—the crucial clue regarding the Heaven's Eye's weakness, the sole chance of victory he had deciphered over three thousand years.

choice.prompt: Faced with his father's dissipating residual soul, Chen Ji decides—

choices.text: Solemnly bow thrice, accepting his father's will and responsibility
choices.description: Formally accept the inheritance with ancient etiquette, expressing to Chen Tianming his determination to fulfill his unfinished mission.
choices.visible_reward: Gain complete inheritance blessing, Chen Tianming's residual soul dissipates in peace

text.content: Chen Ji knelt on both knees, performing the most solemn son-to-father ritual—three kowtows. The instant his forehead touched the cold stone floor, he felt a warm force pour in from his fontanel—Chen Tianming's final lingering blessing, the ultimate will of forty-nine generations of chess pieces.

dialogue.content: Father, your child has been unfilial, making you wait far too long. But from this day forward, the Chen family's debt shall be repaid by me. The Heaven's Eye's life shall be claimed by me!

choices.description: Without ceremony, continue demanding detailed information from Chen Tianming regarding the Heaven's Eye's weakness.
choices.visible_cost: Miss the final farewell with his father
choices.visible_reward: Gain more detailed intelligence on the Heaven's Eye's weakness

text.content: Chen Ji did not kneel, but instead met Chen Tianming's gaze directly: 'Father, what specifically is the weakness? What preparations must I make? Time is running out, please tell me everything.' A flicker of complexity crossed Chen Tianming's gaze, yet ultimately he nodded and began rapidly explaining the crucial information.

When Chen Tianming's form completely dissipated and the mural fell silent once more, the entire stone chamber plunged into a brief deathly stillness. Then, that stone wall burst open, revealing a staircase descending into darkness, at whose end a faint glimmer of light was barely visible. Chen Ji rose to his feet, the jade pendant in his palm having returned to tranquility, yet he knew his sister's consciousness still slumbered within, awaiting the day he would fulfill his promise.

He walked toward that staircase at a measured pace, each step seeming to tread upon destiny's pulse. Candle flames on both walls ignited of their own accord, illuminating his path. When he reached the staircase's end, an ancient stone door appeared before him, covered in the same runes as the Tianji Record Fragment. And precisely at the door's center, a copper key covered in rust was embedded—the final legacy Chen Tianming had prepared for him over three thousand years.

dialogue.content: Father, what kind of door... did you truly want me to open?

text.content: The instant Chen Ji touched that key, another torrent of information surged into his Mental Sea. This time, he clearly perceived the scene beyond the stone door—a void shrouded in endless darkness, within whose deepest reaches a colossal eye that blotted out the heavens was slowly opening, as if awakening from ancient slumber, turning its gaze toward him. The moment their eyes met across the void, every hair on Chen Ji's body stood on end, a terror from the depths of primal life-instinct nearly suffocating him. Yet he did not retreat; instead, a faint smile appeared on his face.

He retrieved the key from the stone door, its touch cool and heavy in his palm. This key was not merely a tool for opening passages—it was the crystalline will of forty-nine generations of the Chen family, the starting point of his path of vengeance, the筹码 with which he would transform his destiny. The moment Chen Ji tucked the key into his chest, Chen Nian within the jade pendant seemed to sense something, a flicker of light passing through her illusory eyes—that was the light of hope, also the omen of an impending emergence from its cocoon.

Outside the stone door, the night sky over Tianqing Sect was shrouded in dense black clouds, thunder rumbling in the distance. Chen Ji emerged from the secret chamber, lifting his gaze toward that celestial dome enveloped in gloom. He knew that from the moment he grasped this key, he had no path of retreat. The Heaven's Eye had already sensed his existence, the door to the final battle swung wide open for him. And he, Chen Ji, would take this key as a blade, cleaving apart the darkness shrouding all beneath heaven, returning to the world its bright and open cosmos.
